title: Made-in-China product and supplier results
description: One row per unique Made-in-China supplier, with source attribution, normalized prices and MOQs, displayed audit and membership signals, optional public profile details, and every matched product preserved.

search_input.title: Search input
search_input.description: The first keyword or resolved image filename that matched this supplier.

search_type.title: Search type
search_type.description: Search mode that first produced this supplier row.

matched_search_inputs.title: Matched search inputs
matched_search_inputs.description: Every keyword or image filename that matched this supplier.

name.title: Product name
name.description: The first product title matched for this supplier.

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Made-in-China product identifier parsed from the listing.

price.title: Displayed price
price.description: Price or price range exactly as displayed by Made-in-China.

price_min.title: Minimum price
price_min.description: Normalized lower bound of the displayed product price.

price_max.title: Maximum price
price_max.description: Normalized upper bound of the displayed product price.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code inferred from the displayed price.

min_order.title: Minimum order
min_order.description: Minimum order exactly as displayed in the search result.

moq_unit.title: MOQ unit
moq_unit.description: Unit associated with the minimum order quantity.

product_attributes.title: Product attributes
product_attributes.description: Visible product specifications such as material, finish, warranty, and size.

secured_trading.title: Secured Trading
secured_trading.description: Whether the listing displays Made-in-China's Secured Trading indicator.

is_sponsored.title: Sponsored result
is_sponsored.description: Whether Made-in-China identifies the search result as promoted or enhanced advertising.

match_rank.title: Match rank
match_rank.description: One-based result position for the first product match retained for this supplier.

result_page.title: Result page or batch
result_page.description: Keyword result page or image-search batch where the first match appeared.

vendor_name.title: Supplier name
vendor_name.description: Public supplier or manufacturer company name displayed by Made-in-China.

vendor_profile_url.title: Supplier profile URL
vendor_profile_url.description: Canonical public Made-in-China supplier profile URL.

company_id.title: Company ID
company_id.description: Made-in-China company identifier parsed from public listing metadata or profile links.

audited_supplier.title: Audited Supplier
audited_supplier.description: Whether Made-in-China displays the Audited Supplier badge. This reports a marketplace label, not an independent endorsement by the Actor.

leading_factory.title: Leading Factory
leading_factory.description: Whether Made-in-China displays its Industry-leading Audited Factory badge.

member_type.title: Member type
member_type.description: Displayed membership such as Gold Member or Diamond Member.

member_since.title: Member since
member_since.description: First membership year displayed on the public supplier profile.

supplier_rating.title: Supplier rating
supplier_rating.description: Public supplier rating displayed by Made-in-China when available.

supplier_capability_index.title: Supplier capability index
supplier_capability_index.description: Number of capability stars visibly displayed by Made-in-China.

supplier_from.title: Supplier location
supplier_from.description: Public province, city, or country text displayed for the supplier.

business_type.title: Business type
business_type.description: Public company classification such as Manufacturer/Factory or Trading Company.

main_products.title: Main products
main_products.description: Public main-products list displayed on the supplier profile.

year_established.title: Year established
year_established.description: Public establishment date or year displayed on the supplier profile.

employee_count.title: Employees
employee_count.description: Public employee count displayed on the supplier profile.

address.title: Company address
address.description: Public company address displayed on the supplier profile.

average_response_time.title: Average response time
average_response_time.description: Average response time displayed on the public supplier profile.

supplier_capability_tags.title: Supplier capability tags
supplier_capability_tags.description: Visible capability labels such as ODM Services or Customization from Samples.

company_description.title: Company description
company_description.description: Public company introduction displayed on the supplier profile.

matched_products.title: Matched products
matched_products.description: Every distinct product match retained for this supplier and source input.

overview.title: Supplier results
overview.description: Unique suppliers with product matches, audit status, normalized prices and MOQs, membership, and profile details.
